section.title: org.osgi.service.transaction.control.jdbc
section.para: Transaction Control JDBC Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: JDBCConnectionProvider - A specialized ResourceProvider suitable for obtaining JDBC connections.
JDBCConnectionProviderFactory - A factory for creating JDBCConnectionProvider instances

section.title: public interface JDBCConnectionProvider extends ResourceProvider<Connection>
section.para: A specialized ResourceProvider suitable for obtaining JDBC connections.
Instances of this interface may be available in the Service Registry, or can be created using a JDBCConnectionProviderFactory.

section.title: public interface JDBCConnectionProviderFactory
section.para: A factory for creating JDBCConnectionProvider instances
This factory can be used if the JDBCConnectionProvider should not be a public service, for example to protect a username/password.

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public static final String CONNECTION_LIFETIME = "osgi.connection.lifetime"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum amount of time that connections in the pool should remain open

section.title: public static final String CONNECTION_POOLING_ENABLED = "osgi.connection.pooling.enabled"
section.para: The property used to determine whether connection pooling is enabled for this resource provider

section.title: public static final String CONNECTION_TIMEOUT = "osgi.connection.timeout"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum amount of time that the pool should wait for a connection

section.title: public static final String IDLE_TIMEOUT = "osgi.idle.timeout"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum amount of time that connections in the pool should remain idle before being closed

section.title: public static final String LOCAL_ENLISTMENT_ENABLED = "osgi.local.enabled"
section.para: The property used to determine whether local enlistment is enabled for this resource provider

section.title: public static final String MAX_CONNECTIONS = "osgi.connection.max"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum number of connections that should be held in the pool

section.title: public static final String MIN_CONNECTIONS = "osgi.connection.min"
section.para: The property used to set the minimum number of connections that should be held in the pool

section.title: public static final String OSGI_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER = "osgi.recovery.identifier"
section.para: The property used to set the recovery identifier that should be used by this resource

section.title: public static final String USE_DRIVER = "osgi.use.driver"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum number of connections that should be held in the pool

section.title: public static final String XA_ENLISTMENT_ENABLED = "osgi.xa.enabled"

section.title: public static final String XA_RECOVERY_ENABLED = "osgi.recovery.enabled"

section.title: public JDBCConnectionProvider getProviderFor(DataSourceFactory dsf, Properties jdbcProperties, Map<String, Object> resourceProviderProperties)

formalpara.title: jdbcProperties
formalpara.para: The properties to pass to the DataSourceFactory in order to create the underlying DataSource

formalpara.title: resourceProviderProperties
formalpara.para: Configuration properties to pass to the JDBC Resource Provider runtime

section.para: Create a private JDBCConnectionProvider using a DataSourceFactory. This call may fail with a TransactionException if the supplied configuration is invalid. Examples of invalid configuration include:

listitem.para: The properties request XA enlistment, but the provider implementation only supports local enlistment
The properties attempt to set a recovery alias, but the provider does not support recovery.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A JDBCConnectionProvider that can be used in transactions

section.title: public void releaseProvider(JDBCConnectionProvider provider)
section.para: Release a JDBCConnectionProvider instance that has been created by this factory. Released instances are eligible to be shut down and have any remaining open connections closed.
Note that all JDBCConnectionProvider instances created by this factory service are implicitly released when the factory service is released by this bundle.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the supplied resource was not created by this factory service instance.
